name: 酷狗榜单
description: 抓取酷狗排行榜（TOP500、飙升榜、网络红歌榜、DJ热歌榜）并同步到本地库。支持多选榜单，未匹配的歌曲通过在线源补全或外部占位由后端auto-match补全。首页以「本地歌单」分区直接展示已入库榜单，无需导入即可播放。TOP500使用V3 API一次拉满全部500首。
author: ray5378

configSchema.label: 选择榜单（可多选）
configSchema.help: 选择要同步到本地音乐库的酷狗榜单，可以多选

configSchema.label: 首页展示歌单数
configSchema.help: 首页「本地歌单」展示多少个已入库榜单(1~50,默认 6)

configSchema.label: 首页显示顺序
configSchema.help: 数值越小越靠前。QQ音乐榜单/酷狗榜单/网易云榜单按此值在首页「本地歌单」分区排列(1~100,默认 31)

configSchema.label: 参与每日定时同步
configSchema.help: 关闭后,每天定点那次自动同步会跳过本插件(手动刷新按钮仍然可用)。

configSchema.label: 容器启动时拉取一次
configSchema.help: 打开后,MusicFlow 每次启动/重启会补拉一次本插件的歌单(适合榜单类插件保持最新)。

documentation:
### 功能介绍
自动抓取酷狗排行榜并同步到本地音乐库，支持多选榜单，在首页「本地歌单」分区展示（直连本地库播放，无需导入）。

使用 V3 API 一次拉取全部歌曲，无需配置分页，TOP500 直接拉满全部 500 首。

### 配置说明
- 选择要同步的榜单，可以多选；
- 配置首页「本地歌单」展示的榜单数量；
- 首页按所选榜单独立展示分区。

en.name: Kugou Charts
en.description: Fetches Kugou ranking charts (TOP 500, Trending, Online Red Songs, DJ Hot Songs) and syncs them into the local library. Multiple charts can be selected; unmatched songs are backfilled via online sources, external placeholders, or the backend auto-match. Charts are shown directly in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page, ready to play without import. TOP 500 uses the V3 API to pull all 500 songs in one request.

rankIds.label: Select charts (multi-select)
rankIds.help: Select which Kugou charts to sync into the local music library (multi-select)

homeCount.label: Home playlists shown
homeCount.help: How many imported charts to show in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page (1~50, default 6)

sortOrder.label: Home display order
sortOrder.help: Lower value sorts first. QQ Music / Kugou / Netease charts are arranged by this value in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page (1~100, default 31)

scheduleEnabled.label: Participate in daily scheduled sync
scheduleEnabled.help: When off, the daily auto-sync will skip this plugin (the manual refresh button still works).

runOnBoot.label: Fetch once on container startup
runOnBoot.help: When on, MusicFlow will fetch this plugin playlists once on every start/restart (keeps chart-type plugins up to date).

batchParallel.label: Allow parallel execution
batchParallel.help: Off (default): this plugin's scheduled/batch jobs always run serially in the global queue; On: allowed to run in parallel with other plugins that enable this switch (uses more CPU but is faster).

en.documentation:
### Features
Automatically fetches Kugou ranking charts and syncs them into the local music library. Supports multi-selecting charts; charts are shown in the "Local Playlists" section on the home page (played straight from the local library, no import needed).

Uses the V3 API to pull all songs in one request — no pagination config needed; TOP 500 pulls all 500 songs at once.

### Configuration
- Select the charts to sync (multi-select);
- Configure how many charts the "Local Playlists" section shows on the home page;
- The home page shows a separate section per selected chart.
